function.name: find_item
function.description: Look up an item on this customer's master from the words the counter said. Always call this before record_count. Returns up to three candidates with short names and a confidence.

spoken_text.description: The item words exactly as the counter said them, without the quantity.

function.name: record_count
function.description: Record one counted line. The only way to record anything. Use an item_code that find_item returned; never invent one.

unit_as_spoken.description: The unit exactly as spoken — case, box, drum, metres, each. The app converts it.

function.name: undo_last
function.description: Remove the line just recorded. Call this on "no", "wrong" or "no no" straight after a readback.

function.name: set_location
function.description: Set the location the count is happening at, from the words the counter said. Locations come from a list the office uploaded and cannot be created.

spoken_text.description: The place name as the counter said it.

function.name: read_total
function.description: Read back the running total for this location.

function.name: pause
function.description: Stop recording. Call this on "wait", "hang on", "stop" or "pause", say OK, and stay silent.

function.name: resume
function.description: Start recording again after a pause.

function.name: next_line
function.description: Review mode only. Move to the next row of the sheet and return it.

function.name: confirm_line
function.description: Review mode only. Accept the row as it stands and move on. Call this on "yes" or "next".

function.name: correct_line
function.description: Review mode only. Set a new number on the row being read.

unit_as_spoken.description: The unit as spoken, if one was said.

function.name: jump_to
function.description: Review mode only. Jump to a row by name.

spoken_text.description: The item words the counter said.
